in_marathi.name: Nidhya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Intelligent One, Treasury, Womb
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nidhya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Nidhya is a Sanskrit and Hindi name that is derived from the root word 'nidh', which means 'to hide' or 'to conceal'. It is also associated with the Goddess Nidhya, who is believed to be the protector of treasures and the embodiment of intelligence. The name Nidhya can be interpreted as 'Intelligent One', 'Treasury', or 'Womb'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl.
